name: Bug report
about: Reproduce a problem using a minimal project or filtered receipt
title: ""
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

**Versions:** plugin/tag/commit, Unreal build, Windows, Python, Codex; Blender if relevant.

**Expected behavior and actual behavior:**

**Minimal reproduction:** exact steps, project/map/revision state, whether the editor
is connected, geometry/navigation coverage and whether the operation was saved.

**Evidence:** filtered error/receipt and relevant source hashes. Preserve the
first failed attempt. Do not retry an uncertain mutation to reproduce it.

**Privacy:** remove credentials, private paths, proprietary content and conversations.
Report vulnerabilities privately through SECURITY.md rather than this template.
